parameters.content:
## Workflow A - load & group the Newstex snapshot (no LLM by default)
1. Open the form URL (Form Trigger -> Production/Test URL) and upload all six .jsonl files at once.
2. Rules only: normalize, exact copies, DE/NL translations (same author, nearest EN within 15 min), roundups, TF-IDF + named-entity + event-type grouping, average-link with 36 h span cap.
3. Optional escalation: set `USE_LLM_CLUSTER_CHECK: true` in *Prepare cluster checks* and select the OpenAI credential. A small model may only SPLIT clusters (about 40 calls, cents).
4. Results replace the rows in Data Tables `lb_stories` and `lb_articles` (created automatically). *Run report* shows counts and cost.
Workflow setting "binary mode" must stay **separate**.
